topic: Memory Grove background atmosphere and depth
currentUserGoal: Make the Memory Grove and skill-tree backgrounds feel richer and less like flat dark-green panels without obscuring the readable skill web or harming performance.
workCompleted: Allowed the existing meadow artwork to ghost through the Memory Grove's outer shell instead of covering it with an almost opaque flat overlay.
Added restrained woven-grove texture layers to the run summary, Memory Web, and selected-memory detail panels.
Added a faint meadow layer inside the web viewport so the skill nodes feel rooted in the game's world rather than suspended in an empty green void.
Added deterministic dappled light, edge roots, low grass silhouettes, title flourishes, and a small pool of drifting pollen and spores behind the skill connectors.
Kept all new atmosphere bounded to fixed display objects and preallocated typed-array motion data, with no per-frame object creation or active tweens.
